loop: module 8.1 Solid Shapes: the first reSHape module, student-lens gauntlet
bar: a 14-year-old beginner finishes every lesson unaided; measured by the cs-student-beginner, cs-student-moderate and cs-student-advanced lenses working each lesson in headless Chromium on the dev server (DEV_ROLE=student, one dev_student cookie per lens) and by fresh critics reading their transcripts
round0_finding: no lesson opened reSHape: preview: "reshape" gave a code editor and the retired JSCAD iframe, no Build tools, no saved model, no model-aware check
host_built: components/reshape/ReshapeStudio.tsx extracted from SandboxWorkspace (2257 -> ~490 lines); a lesson mounts the same Build + Code experience the sandbox does
Build writes script.js (debounced toScript); reload rebuilds the doc by running script.js once through the sandboxed iframe; the Code side shows the same B-rep viewport
lesson.mode (visual | code | both) through the existing lesson-mode resolver; teacher class/assignment overrides still win

requirement type model (lib/model-check.ts, pure): feature kinds + named fields, tolerance 0.01, derived fields (box width/depth/height, hole across, sketch width/depth/across, shell open: true); refused features do not count; messages in the course's words
grade() takes { modelDoc, refusals } as its 4th argument; a reSHape lesson re-grades 250 ms after every model change
scripts/check-reshape-solutions.mjs builds every reference and starter on the kernel: reference must pass with no refusal, starter must fail
dev server: in-memory lesson-state and submissions, keyed by a dev_student cookie
